day_focus: Run fit20 clean, then tighten one household system so Boaz’s week and the home’s ops board both get simpler before Thursday.
checkin: Son, Tactical Tuesday is for building the rails, not filling every hour. Do the fit20 shift with a steady head, then pick one process that actually serves Maria and the boys—something small enough to finish and real enough to stick. Boaz turns fifteen in five days; presence at home will outrank a perfect checklist. Meet the Lord first, keep the house calm, and let the systems carry what they can so you don’t have to.
